summary.text: Lisa Barnes is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 11 since January 1, 2021, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 7, from 2019 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Barnes graduated from Southern Nash High School, earned an A.A. from Peace College and a B.A. in political science from North Carolina State University.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a real estate paralegal and in the agribusiness industry.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists Barnes as chair of the Agriculture, Energy, and Environment Committee and the Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural and Economic Resources Committee, and a member of the Appropriations/Base Budget, Education/Higher Education, Rules and Operations of the Senate, and Health Care committees.
